Q2
query:
MATCH (s:Sales)-[:INCLUDES]->(p:Product)
RETURN 
    p.ProductName,
    SUM(s.SalesAmount) AS TotalSales
ORDER BY TotalSales DESC
LIMIT 10;

name: Q3
query:
MATCH (s:Sales)-[:HANDLED_BY]->(e:Employee)
RETURN 
    e.FirstName + ' ' + e.LastName AS EmployeeName,
    SUM(s.SalesAmount) AS TotalSales
ORDER BY TotalSales DESC;

name: Q4
query:
MATCH (s:Sales)-[:OCCURRED_ON]->(t:Time)
RETURN 
t.Year,
SUM(s.SalesAmount) AS TotalSales
ORDER BY t.Year;

name: Q%
query:
MATCH (c1:Customer)-[:PURCHASED]->(s1:Sales)-[:INCLUDES]->(p:Product)
MATCH (c2:Customer)-[:PURCHASED]->(s2:Sales)-[:INCLUDES]->(p)
WHERE c1 < c2
RETURN 
    c1.CustomerID,
    c2.CustomerID,
    p.ProductName,
    COUNT(*) AS TimesBoughtSameProduct
ORDER BY TimesBoughtSameProduct DESC;
